40009477.author: पदार्थः
40009477.content: धर्मात्मा righteous, सः he, लक्ष्मणाग्रजः Lakshmana's elder brother, सहसुग्रीवः along with Sugriva, ऋष्यमूकात् Rishyamuka, वालिविक्रमपालिताम् ruled by Vali's valour, किष्किन्धाम् Kishkinda, जगाम went.

40009477.author: Translation
40009477.content: Lakshmana's righteous elder brother left Rishyamuka with Sugriva for Kishkinda protected by Vali's valour.

40009478.author: पदार्थः
40009478.content: रामः Rama, काञ्चनभूषितम् adorned with gold, महत् great, चापम् bow, समुद्यम्य  getting ready, आदित्यसङ्कशान् radiant as the Sun, रणसाधकान् potent in war, शरान् arrows, गृहीत्वा taking up.

40009478.author: Translation
40009478.content: Getting ready to go, Rama took up his great bow and arrows adorned with gold and potent in war looking (dazzling) like the Sun.

40009479.author: पदार्थः
40009479.content: महात्मनः greatsoul, तस्य राघवस्य that Rama's, अग्रतः in front, संहतग्रीवः strongnecked, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, महाबलः powerful, लक्ष्मणश्च and Lakshmana, ययौ went.

40009479.author: Translation
40009479.content: The strongnecked Sugriva and mighty Lakshmana walked in front of the highsouled Rama.

40009480.author: पदार्थः
40009480.content: पृष्ठतः behind them, वीरः courageous, हनुमान् Hanuman, नलः Nala, वानरः monkey, नीलश्च and Nila, महातेजाः brilliant, हरियूथपयूथपः the head of monkey leaders, तारश्चैव and  Tara.

40009480.author: Translation
40009480.content: Brave and brilliant Hanuman, Nala, Nila, and Tara among the leaders of the monkeys  walked behind.

40009481.author: पदार्थः
40009481.content: ते they, वीक्षमाणा enjoying the view, पुष्पभारावलम्बिनः bending down due to the weight of the flowers, वृक्षांश्च trees, प्रसन्नाम्बुवहाः carrying pure waters, सागरंगमाः flowing into the sea, सरितः rivers.

40009481.author: Translation
40009481.content: They saw (on the way) trees bent down with the load of flowers, and rivers with pure water flowing into the sea.

40009482.author: पदार्थः
40009482.content: कन्दराणि valleys, शैलांश्च mountains, निर्दराणि caverns, तथा similarly, गुहाः caves, मुख्यानि prominent, शिखराणि peaks, प्रियदर्शनाः pleasing to look at, दरीश्च  deep caves.

40009482.author: Translation
40009482.content: (They saw) beautiful valleys, mountains, caves, prominent peaks with deep caverns.

40009483.author: पदार्थः
40009483.content: मार्गे on the way, पर्णै with leaves, वैदूर्यविमलैः clear like Vaidurya, अकोशकुडमलैः buds, पद्मैश्च and lotuses, शोभितान् beautiful, सजलान् with water, तटाकान् tanks, अवलोकयन् observing

40009483.author: Translation
40009483.content: Observing on the way delightful lotus buds with leaves like Vaidurya, clear water and full tanks (They moved on).

40009484.author: पदार्थः
40009484.content: कारण्डैः with karandas (ducks), सारसैः with cranes, हंसैः with swans, वञ्जुलैः with vanjulas, जलकुक्कुटैः with water fowls, चक्रवाकैः with chakravakas, तथा similarly, अन्यैः with others, शकुनैः with birds, रुपनादितान् warbling melodiously

40009484.author: Translation
40009484.content: Ducks, cranes, swans, vanjulas, waterfowls, chakravakas and other birds warbling melodiously.

40009485.author: पदार्थः
40009485.content: मृदुशष्पाङ्कुराहारान् feeding on tender grass, निर्भयान् without fear, वनगोचरान् roaming the forest, स्थलीषु on the ground, सर्वतः all around, चरतः roaming, स्थितान् standing, हरिणान् deer, अपश्यन् saw.

40009485.author: Translation
40009485.content: They observed deer feeding on tender grass on the ground around without fear, some standing and some roaming the forest

40009486.author: पदार्थः
40009486.content: तटाकवैरिणः destroyers of tanks, शुक्लदन्तविभूषितान् adorned with white tusks, घोरान् terrific, एकचरान् wandering alone, कूलघातिनः destroyers of the banks, द्विरदान् elephants (those that have two tusks).

40009486.author: Translation
40009486.content: Observing terrific elephants adorned with white tusks wandering alone destroying the tanks, shattering the banks.

40009487.author: पदार्थः
40009487.content: मत्तान् intoxicated, गिरितटोत्कृष्टान् that were knocking the edges of mountain slopes, जङ्गमान् moving, पर्वतानिव mountainlike, वारिदप्रख्यान् resembling (dark) rainbearing clouds, महीरेणुसमुक्षितान् covered with dust of the earth, वारणान् elephants.

40009487.author: Translation
40009487.content: (Observing) intoxicated elephants knocking the edges of mountain slopes, elephants resembling (dark) rainbearing clouds, elephants like moving mountains, elephants with dust covered all over the body.

40009488.author: पदार्थः
40009488.content: सुग्रीववशवर्तिनः faithful to Sugriva, वने in the forest, अन्यान् other, वनचरांश्च wild animals, खेचरान् those flying in the sky, विहङ्गमांश्च and birds, पश्यन्तः seeing, त्वरिताः fast, जग्मुः went.

40009488.author: Translation
40009488.content: Following Sugriva faithfully, they proceeded swiftly, observing animals of the forest and birds flying in the sky.

40009489.author: पदार्थः
40009489.content: तेषाम् while they, त्वरितम् swiftly, गच्छताम् were going, रघुनन्दनः delight of the Raghu family, रामः Rama, तत्र there, द्रुमषण्डवनम्  dense forest dense with trees, दृष्ट्वा seeing, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, अब्रवीत् said.

40009489.author: Translation
40009489.content: While walking fast, looking at the forest full of trees Rama, the delight of the Raghus said to Sugriva:

40009490.author: पदार्थः
40009490.content: मेघसङ्घातविपुलः vast like a collection of clouds, पर्यन्तकदलीवृतः surrounded by banana plants all over, एषः that, वृक्षषण्डः cluster of trees, आकाशे in the sky, मेघः cloud, इव like, प्रकाशते splendid.

40009490.author: Translation
40009490.content: 'This cluster of trees surrounded by plantain groves look splendid like a vast collection of clouds in the sky.

40009491.author: पदार्थः
40009491.content: सखे O friend, एतत् this, किम् what, ज्ञातुम् to know, इच्छामि wish, मम mine, कौतूहलम् curiosity, त्वया by you, कौतूहलापनयनम् clear to my curiosity, कर्तुम् do, इच्चामि I wish to.

40009491.author: Translation
40009491.content: 'O friend I wish to know what this is? Could you answer my curiosity?'

40009492.author: पदार्थः
40009492.content: महात्मनः great soul, तस्य राघवस्य that Raghava's, तत् वचनम् those words, श्रुत्वा hearing, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, अथ then, गच्छन्नेव walking, तत् that, महत्  extensive, वनम् forest, आचचक्षे started narrating.

40009492.author: Translation
40009492.content: On hearing great Rama's words while walking in the extensive forest,  Sugriva started narrating:

40009493.author: पदार्थः
40009493.content: राघव Raghava, उद्यानवनसम्पन्नम् beautiful gardens, स्वादुमूलफलोदकम् tasty roots fruits and water, विस्तीर्णम् vast, एतत् all this, श्रमनाशनम् relieves tiresomeness of wearied people, आश्रमम् hermitage.

40009493.author: Translation
40009493.content: 'O Raghava this is a hermitage, enchanting with vast gardens and trees bearing sweet fruits, full of tasty roots and water that relieves tiresomeness (of travellers).

40009494.author: पदार्थः
40009494.content: अत्र here, संश्रितव्रताः strict followers of austere practices, नियतम्  highly disciplined, अधःशीर्षाः with head down, जलशायिनः immersed in water, सप्तजनाः नाम called seven ascetics (Saptajana), सप्तैव all the seven, मुनयः ascetics, आसन् were residing.

40009494.author: Translation
40009494.content: Here dwelt seven sages called the Saptajana, strict in their austere vows and highly disciplined, all seven lying immersed in water with heads bowed down.

40009495.author: पदार्थः
40009495.content: सप्तरात्रे on the seventh night, वायुना with air, कृताहाराः as food, अचलवासिनः without motion, सप्तभिः  seven, वर्षशतैः hundred years, सकलेबराः with their bodies, दिवम् heaven, याताः attained.

40009495.author: Translation
40009495.content: 'These seven sages used to live on air and that too once in seven nights. They lived for seven hundred years performing penance with motionlessness and attained heaven along with their bodies.

40009496.author: पदार्थः
40009496.content: द्रुमप्राकारसंवृतम् surrounded by a row of trees, एवं in this way, आश्रम् hermitage, तेषाम् their, प्रभावानां by virtue of their power of penance, सेन्द्रैः by those including Indra, सुरासुरैरपि gods and demons, सुदुराधर्षम् very difficult to enter.

40009496.author: Translation
40009496.content: 'By virtue of the power of their penance, this hermitage surrounded by a row of trees is impenetrable even for demons and gods including Indra.

40009497.author: पदार्थः
40009497.content: पक्षिणः birds, तथा so also, अन्ये other, वनचारिणः wild animals, एतत् this place, वर्जयन्ति avoid, ये whoever, मोहात् by ignorance, अत्र there, विशन्ति enter, ते they, पुनः again, न निवर्तन्ति do not return.

40009497.author: Translation
40009497.content: 'Birds and wild animals avoid the hermitage and whoever enters there out of ignorance never returns.

40009498.author: पदार्थः
40009498.content: राघव Rama, अत्र here, सकलाक्षराः all words, विभूषणरवाश्च jingling of ornaments, तूर्यगीतस्वराश्चात्र sounds of songs and windinstruments (instruments that make a sound when wind passes through), श्रूयन्ते heard, दिव्यः divine, गन्धश्च fragrance also.

40009498.author: Translation
40009498.content: 'O Rama, one can hear pleasant sounds of jingling ornaments (of nymphs), of songs and windinstruments here. One can inhale divine fragrance, too.

40009499.author: पदार्थः
40009499.content: त्रेताग्नयोऽपि three sacred fires (Dakshinagni, Ahavaniya, Garhapatya fires), दीप्यन्ते shining, वृक्षाग्रान् treetops, वेष्टयन्निव as if enveloping, कपोताङ्गारुणः red like the pigeon's feet, घनः thick,दूमो smoke, एषः this, प्रकाशते हि glows.

40009499.author: Translation
40009499.content: 'The three sacred fires keep burning and the thick smoke they emit resembles the red feet of  pigeons. It shines forth as if enveloping the treetops.

40009500.author: पदार्थः
40009500.content: धूमसंसक्तमस्तकाः treetops covered with thick smoke, वृक्षाः trees, मेघजालप्रतिच्छन्नाः concealed by clouds, यथा as, प्रकाशन्ते glowing, वैढूर्य Vaidurya, गिरियः a mountain, एते   appears.

40009500.author: Translation
40009500.content: 'These treetops covered with thick smoke glow like mountains of Vaidurya concealed by a cluster of clouds.

40009501.author: पदार्थः
40009501.content: धर्मात्मन् O righteous one, राघव Rama, तेषाम् उद्दिश्य contemplating about them, भ्रात्रा  brother, लक्ष्मणेन सह along with Lakshmana, प्रयतः humbly, सयताञ्जलिः with folded hands, प्रणामम् offer obeisance, कुरु do, ताम् them.

40009501.author: Translation
40009501.content: 'O rigteous Rama you and your brother Lakshmana humbly offer obeisance to them(sacred hermitage and sages Saptajana) with folded hands and meditate on them.

40009502.author: पदार्थः
40009502.content: राम Rama, भावितात्मनाम्  sacred souls, तेषाम् मुनीनाम् to those sages, ये whoever, प्रणमन्ति offer obeisance, तेषाम् to them, शरीरे in body, किञ्चित् not even a little, अशुभम् inauspicious, न दृश्यते will not be seen.

40009502.author: Translation
40009502.content: 'O Rama, nothing inauspicious happens to them who offer obeisance to those highly spiritual sacred sages.'

40009503.author: पदार्थः
40009503.content: ततः then, रामः Rama, भ्रात्रा with brother, लक्ष्मणेन सह along with Lakshmana, कृताञ्जलिः with folded hands offered obeisance, महात्मानः great souls, तान् them, ऋषीन् समुद्दिश्य thinking of the seers, अभ्यवादयत् saluted.

40009503.author: Translation
40009503.content: Rama and Lakshmana  offered salutations with folded hands in memory of those great sages, great souls.

40009504.author: पदार्थः
40009504.content: धर्मात्मा righteous, रामः Rama, भ्राता brother, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, वानराश्चैव and monkeys, अभिवाद्य  offered obeisance, संहृष्टमानसाः  delighted at heart, जग्मुः went.

40009504.author: Translation
40009504.content: Righteous Rama, Lakshmana, Sugriva and all the monkeys offered obeisance and proceeded delighted at heart.

40009505.author: पदार्थः
40009505.content: ते they, तस्मात् from there, सप्तजनाश्रमात् the hermitage of seven seers, दूरम् long distance, अध्वानम् path, गत्वा on going, वालिपालिताम् ruled by Vali, दुराधर्षाम् unassailable, तां किष्किन्धाम् that Kishkinda, ददृशुः  beheld

40009505.author: Translation
40009505.content: Walking a long distance from the hermitage of the seven seers, they beheld the unassailable Kishkinda ruled by Vali.

40009506.author: पदार्थः
40009506.content: ततः then, उदितोग्रतेजसः possessed of fierce lustre, रामानुजरामवानराः Lakshmana, Rama and the monkeys, शस्त्राणि weapons, प्रगृह्य took, शत्रोः enemy, वधाय to kill, सुरेशात्मजवीर्यपालिताम् ruled by the valour of the son of Indra, पुरीम् capital, पुनः again, इह there, आगताः reached.

40009506.author: Translation
40009506.content: Rama and Lakshmana of fierce lustre, and the monkeys took hold of the weapons to kill the enemy and reached the capital ruled by the valour of Vali, son of Indra. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे त्रयोदशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirteenth sarga of Kishkindakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
